sections.st: Sample Kit Packaging Manufacturer India — Pharma Sample Kits GMP Cleanroom · Vapi
leads: Trizen Packaging manufactures sample kit packaging from our Cleanroom Class 8, GMP-compliant, ISO 9001:2015 certified facility in Vapi, Gujarat — custom thermoformed PETG and APET trays for pharmaceutical sample kits, clinical sample packaging, diagnostic sample kits, and pharma OEM sample sets. Sample packaging manufacturer from Vapi for pharmaceutical companies, pharma marketers, and clinical diagnostic companies.

Pharmaceutical sample kit packaging organises multiple drug samples, clinical samples, or diagnostic test components in a defined kit format for distribution to healthcare professionals, clinical trial sites, or diagnostic laboratories. The thermoformed tray holds every kit component in its correct position — ensuring the sample kit contents are complete, undamaged, and presented in the correct clinical or dispensing sequence.

strips.title: Incomplete Sample Kits — Missing Components at Clinical Delivery
strips.desc: Problem: Pharmaceutical sample kit packaging where components are not individually held in defined positions allows components to fall out during handling — clinical samples arrive incomplete. Solution: Individual cavity for every kit component confirmed from complete kit contents list.

strips.title: GMP Documentation for Clinical Trial Sample Kits
strips.desc: Problem: Clinical trial sample kit packaging requires GMP documentation — the sample kit packaging is part of the clinical trial supply chain, which is subject to GMP audit. Solution: GMP batch documentation for all clinical trial sample kit packaging — batch records, material CoA, dimensional inspection per run.

strips.title: Diagnostic Sample Integrity — Component Position Maintained
strips.desc: Problem: Diagnostic sample kits where sample tubes, reagents, and collection accessories move freely inside the kit tray risk sample mixing or contamination — a patient safety issue. Solution: Individual defined cavity for every diagnostic kit component — sample tubes and reagents cannot contact each other.
